preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 2 * 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**9 for N, K in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of friends N is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= 10**9 for N, K in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of slices per pizza K is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] * K % N == 0 for i, (N, K) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the number of pizzas bought multiplied by the number of slices per pizza is divisible by the number of friends, ensuring no slices are left over.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] * K // N == N for i, (N, K) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the number of pizzas bought multiplied by the number of slices per pizza divided by the number of friends equals the number of friends, ensuring each friend gets an equal number of slices.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == (N + K - 1) // K for i, (N, K) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the number of pizzas bought is the minimum number required to ensure each friend gets an equal number of slices without any slices left over.
